env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env GOAMD64=v1
env CGO_ENABLED=0

cd m
logos eject -o out
exists out/winonly/value_windows.go
exists out/winleaf/value_windows.go
exists out/archonly/value_arm64.go
exists out/tagonly/value.go
exists out/onlytests/value_windows_test.go
exists out/_logos_deps/example.com/dependency@v1.0.0/value_windows.go
exists out/_logos_deps/example.com/dependency@v1.0.0/nested/value_arm64.go
! exists out/testdata/ignored_windows.go
! exists out/_scratch/ignored_windows.go
! exists out/.hidden/ignored_windows.go
! exists out/nestedmodule/ignored_windows.go
! exists out/ignored.go
grep 'example.com/dependency v1.0.0 => ./_logos_deps/example.com/dependency@v1.0.0' out/go.mod
cd out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -tags=eject_extra ./...
env GOOS=windows
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go list ./winonly ./winleaf ./onlytests
stdout '^example.com/inactive/winonly$'
stdout '^example.com/inactive/winleaf$'
stdout '^example.com/inactive/onlytests$'
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=arm64
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build example.com/dependency/nested
cd ../..

# A module with no host-selected package still has a complete eject.
env GOARCH=amd64
cd emptyhost
logos eject -o out
exists out/value_windows.go
cd out
env GOOS=windows
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/inactive

go 1.27

require example.com/dependency v1.0.0

replace example.com/dependency => ../dependency

-- m/main.lgo --
package inactive

func Host() int { return 1 }

-- m/winonly/value_windows.lgo --
package winonly

import (
	"example.com/dependency"
	"example.com/inactive/winleaf"
)

func Value() int { return winleaf.Value() + dependency.Value() }

-- m/winleaf/value_windows.lgo --
package winleaf

func Value() int { return 20 }

-- m/archonly/value_arm64.lgo --
package archonly

func Value() int { return 64 }

-- m/tagonly/value.lgo --
//go:build eject_extra

package tagonly

func Value() int { return 7 }

-- m/onlytests/value_windows_test.lgo --
package onlytests

import "testing"

func TestValue(t *testing.T) {
	var value int? = 42
	if (value ?? 0) != 42 {
		t.Fatal("option value changed")
	}
}

-- m/ignored.lgo --
//go:build ignore

package ignored

func Broken() { noSuchName() }

-- m/testdata/ignored_windows.lgo --
package ignored

func Broken() { noSuchName() }

-- m/_scratch/ignored_windows.lgo --
package ignored

func Broken() { noSuchName() }

-- m/.hidden/ignored_windows.lgo --
package ignored

func Broken() { noSuchName() }

-- m/nestedmodule/go.mod --
module example.com/separate

go 1.27

-- m/nestedmodule/ignored_windows.lgo --
package ignored

func Broken() { noSuchName() }

-- dependency/go.mod --
module example.com/dependency

go 1.27

-- dependency/value_windows.lgo --
package dependency

func Value() int { return 22 }

-- dependency/nested/value_arm64.lgo --
package nested

func Value() int { return 64 }

-- emptyhost/go.mod --
module example.com/emptyhost

go 1.27

-- emptyhost/value_windows.lgo --
package emptyhost

func Value() int { return 42 }
